children: Cohen & Company refinanced its related-party debt, issuing a $5.0 million Amended and Restated Senior Promissory Note to JKD Capital Partners I on Aug 31, 2026, replacing its 2024 note. The new note carries 10% interest, pays quarterly, and matures Aug 31, 2027, with default interest at 11% and no prepayment allowed before Jan 31, 2027. The company combined the unpaid balance of the original note with additional funding, while the prior note was terminated via amendment and restatement with no exit fees disclosed.
